transfer.rationale: ST5 R4c checkpoint (frozen from the current-base scratch dry run before the move; reported with this commit under the operator's 2026-10-06 instruction to finish Settings with self-verification). App-to-owner transfer of the Settings modal shell (322 range lines in 14 ranges) into settings/useSettingsModalState.js (435 lines, five exports) and the stateless settings/SettingsModalContainer.jsx (84 lines, 34 explicit props plus children): a state layer useSettingsModalState (0 inputs, 17 returns) at the old cell position; a behavior hook useSettingsModal (55 inputs, 20 returns: open, close, request-close, discard, sub-tab handlers, the Jira connection test, derived tab values and the Board department-settings openers) called right after the save hook (whose outputs it reads directly) and before the onboarding controller; and three effects layers called at the original effect positions (auto-open, hotkey, tab guards), so every moved effect crosses zero unmoved effects. The hotkey effect reads saveAllSettings and requestCloseGroupManage in its dependency array at render time, so it can only be a layer called after the orchestrator and never a getter; merging the three layers into the modal hook would save 55 lines but conservation reports DIFFERS at effect 24, so it was rejected. A getter for closeGroupManage replaces the direct input in the save hook (the modal hook is declared after it), read only inside handlers. Staying in App by decision: the loadConfig draft-guard prelude and fallback, settingsHeaderAction (reads the onboarding controller, which itself needs closeGroupManage), the gear JSX (its click handler reads onboarding state and two onboarding tests pin its text), groupSaving, groupDraftError, settingsSaveError, the adminSettingsGate call and the performance write before completeAuthRecovery. The container costs +83 combined for one App line, but is built because the plan names it. The seam is much larger than the plan's estimate of 300 lines because the two input lists (123 and 55 names) are each written twice (signature and call site). The combined App-plus-owner total grows only by the 365-line scaffolding allowance. The dashboard.jsx lineCeiling was 11649 through ST5 R4 and ST5 R5 ratchets it to its measured 10,855. The combined ceiling is measured-plus-allowance.
